set.dnssec.parentDsDisabled: Checking via public resolvers is not enabled (Settings → Monitoring → Propagation check). Manually: dig +short DS {{zone}} @1.1.1.1
set.dnssec.parentDsKeyVisible: Tag {{tag}} is visible on all resolvers.
set.dnssec.parentDsKeyGone: Tag {{tag}} is no longer visible on any resolver.
set.dnssec.parentDsStillPublished: The parent zone still serves a DS for this zone. Remove it at the registrar first and wait for the TTL.
set.dnssec.parentDsNoneVisible: No resolver serves a DS for this zone any more.
set.dnssec.parentDsUnknownTags: DS without a matching key in this panel: tag {{tags}}
set.dnssec.parentDsCacheHint: Resolvers cache DS records until the TTL expires – changes at the registrar show up with a delay.
set.dnssec.dnskeyCheckIntro: Checks via DNS whether every authoritative nameserver of the zone serves the new key (tag {{tag}}).
set.dnssec.dnskeyCheckDisabled: Not checked: the DNS check of the nameservers is not enabled (Settings → Monitoring → Propagation check). Check yourself that every authoritative nameserver serves the new key (tag {{tag}}), e.g. with: dig +dnssec DNSKEY {{zone}} @<nameserver>
set.dnssec.dnskeyCheckAllOk: All authoritative nameservers serve the new key (tag {{tag}}).
set.dnssec.dnskeyCheckFailed: Not all nameservers serve the new key yet. Wait for the DNSKEY TTL and check again.
set.dnssec.dnskeyCheckNone: No nameservers could be checked (check the zone's NS records).
set.dnssec.dnskeyCheckTruncated: Too many nameserver addresses – not all of them were checked.
set.dnssec.dnskeyCheckForceConfirm:
Not all authoritative nameservers serve the new key (tag {{tag}}). If you continue now, validating resolvers may treat the zone as bogus (SERVFAIL).

Continue anyway?
set.zoneDetail.dnssecManualRecordHint: The “Add record” form for types like DNSKEY/DS/RRSIG is for advanced manual use only. For normal setups, enable DNSSEC on the zone first – then copy the DS line from the DS assistant into your registrar’s DNSSEC form.
set.zoneDetail.dnssecEnabledOk: DNSSEC has been enabled. Copy the DS line from the DS assistant to your registrar.
